# Add: i64 direct f32 round

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Exact integer is1 above the binary32 halfway value: direct nearest-even conversion gives bits0x5e800001. A double intermediate would incorrectly return0x5e800000 for PromotionV1. Adding binary32zero preserves this finite result. Native finite owned profile; original scalar IEEE slots and explicit private Simulation examples remain separate.
